section.content: 本发明涉及一种机器学习方法及机器学习系统，抑制服务器的处理负荷过剩地变高。在具备具有机器学习模型的车辆(2)和能够与车辆通信的服务器(3)的机器学习系统(1)中进行的对模型参数的值进行机器学习的机器学习方法包括以下步骤：服务器检测服务器的当前的处理负荷；服务器基于处理负荷来决定在服务器及车辆的各自中进行的机器学习的处理量；服务器根据决定的服务器中的机器学习的处理量来对模型参数的值进行机器学习；及车辆根据决定的车辆中的机器学习的处理量来对模型参数的值进行机器学习。服务器在处理负荷相对高时与相对低时相比减少服务器中的机器学习的处理量。

The present invention relates to a machine learning method and a machine learning system, which suppress excessive increase of processing load of a server. A machine learning method for machine learning a model parameter value in a machine learning system (1) provided with a vehicle (2) having a machine learning model and a server (3) capable of communicating with the vehicle includes the steps of detecting a current processing load of the server, determining a processing amount of the machine learning performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load, machine learning the model parameter value by the server according to the determined processing amount of the machine learning in the server, and machine learning the model parameter value by the vehicle according to the determined processing amount of the machine learning in the vehicle. The server reduces the amount of processing of machine learning in the server when the processing load is relatively high compared to relatively low.

Machine learning method and machine learning systemTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning method and a machine learning system.

Background

Conventionally, a system including a vehicle having a machine learning model for controlling a mounted device and a server capable of communicating with the vehicle is known (for example, patent literature 1). For example, in the system described in patent document 1, the server accumulates data acquired from the vehicle as a data set for learning, learns the values of the parameters of the machine learning model based on the accumulated data set, and notifies each vehicle of the learning result. Then, the vehicle performs image recognition processing using a machine learning model that reflects the learning result notified from the server.

In particular, in the system described in patent document 1, when data that is not easily recognized in the vehicle is transmitted from the vehicle to the server, the server updates the values of model parameters of the machine learning model for the vehicle based on data acquired by another vehicle in the same situation as the situation in which the data was acquired, in addition to the data.

Prior art literature

Patent literature

Patent document 1 Japanese patent application laid-open No. 2019-021201

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

In the system described in patent document 1, a server learns a machine learning model of a plurality of vehicles communicating with the server. Thus, there are cases where machine learning of machine learning models of many vehicles must be performed simultaneously in a server. In such a case, the computational load (hereinafter, also referred to as "processing load") of the machine learning process in the server becomes high, and there is a possibility that a significant decrease in the processing capacity of the machine learning process in the server and a stop of the machine learning process are caused.

In view of the above, an object of the present disclosure is to suppress an excessive increase in processing load of a server associated with a machine learning process related to a machine learning model of a vehicle.

Means for solving the problems

The gist of the present disclosure is as follows.

[1] A machine learning method for machine learning values of model parameters constituting a machine learning model in a machine learning system provided with a vehicle having a machine learning model for controlling a mounted device and a server capable of communicating with the vehicle, the machine learning method comprising the steps of:

the vehicle transmits a request signal for requesting machine learning of the value of the model parameter to the server;

the server detects the current processing load of the server;

when the request signal is received from the vehicle, the server determines a processing amount or a processing ratio of the machine learning performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load;

The server performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters based on a training data set for machine learning on the values of the model parameters according to the determined processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning in the server, and

The vehicle machine learns the values of the model parameters based on the training data set according to the determined throughput or processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle,

The server reduces the processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning in the server when the processing load is relatively high, as compared to relatively low.

[2] The machine learning method according to [1] above, wherein the server determines to perform all the processes of the machine learning in the vehicle when the processing load is higher than a predetermined reference processing load, and determines to perform all the processes of the machine learning in the server when the processing load is equal to or lower than the reference processing load.

[3] The machine learning method according to [2], wherein the reference processing load is changed according to the type of the machine learning model.

[4] The machine learning method according to the above [3], the reference processing load being higher in the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the safety of the vehicle than in the case where the machine learning model is a model not associated with the safety of the vehicle.

[5] The machine learning method according to any one of the above [2] to [4], further comprising the step of calculating an expected learning time when the machine learning is performed in the vehicle based on the training data set and an expected communication time required for transmission and reception between the training data set and the model parameter and the server,

The reference processing load is a load of a time obtained by subtracting the expected communication time from the expected learning time or a load lower than the load required for machine learning the value of the model parameter in the server.

[6] A machine learning system comprising a vehicle having a machine learning model for controlling a mounted device and a server capable of communicating with the vehicle, wherein the machine learning system performs machine learning on values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model,

The vehicle is provided with:

a learning request transmitting unit for transmitting a request signal for requesting machine learning of the value of the model parameter to the server, and

A vehicle-side learning unit that performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters based on a training data set for performing machine learning on the values of the model parameters,

The server is provided with:

A processing load detection unit configured to detect a current processing load of the server;

A processing amount determination unit configured to determine, when the request signal is received from the vehicle, a processing amount or a processing ratio of the machine learning performed in each of the server and the vehicle based on the processing load, and

A server-side learning unit that performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters based on the training data set,

The server-side learning unit and the vehicle-side learning unit are each provided with a learning unit that performs machine learning on the value of the model parameter based on the determined processing amount or processing ratio of the machine learning,

The processing amount determining unit reduces the processing amount or the processing ratio of the machine learning in the server-side learning unit when the processing load is relatively high, as compared to relatively low.

Effects of the invention

According to the present disclosure, it is possible to suppress an excessive increase in the processing load of the server accompanying the machine learning process related to the machine learning model of the vehicle.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, embodiments will be described in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings. In the following description, the same reference numerals are given to the same components.

< First embodiment >

Structure of machine learning System

First, the machine learning system 1 according to the first embodiment and a machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 1 to 5. Fig. 1 is a schematic configuration diagram of a machine learning system 1 according to a first embodiment. The machine learning system 1 machine learns a machine learning model specific to each vehicle using a training data set including values of a plurality of state parameters representing states of each vehicle. The machine learning model is used to control devices mounted on a vehicle.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning system 1 includes a plurality of vehicles 2 and a server 3 that can communicate with each other. Each of the plurality of vehicles 2 and the server 3 are configured to be capable of communicating with each other via a communication network 4 including an optical communication line or the like and a wireless base station 5 connected to the communication network 4 via a gateway (not shown). The communication between the vehicle 2 and the wireless base station 5 is communication according to an arbitrary communication standard.

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing a hardware configuration of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 includes an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) 11. The ECU11 has an in-vehicle communication interface 12, a storage device 13, and a processor 14. The in-vehicle communication interface 12 and the storage device 13 are connected to the processor 14 via signal lines. In the present embodiment, one ECU11 is provided in the vehicle 2, but a plurality of ECUs may be provided that are divided for each function.

The in-vehicle communication interface 12 has an interface circuit for connecting the ECU11 to an in-vehicle network 15 in accordance with a standard such as CAN (Controller Area Network: controller area network). The ECU11 communicates with other in-vehicle devices via the in-vehicle communication interface 12.

The storage device 13 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 13 includes, for example, a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM), a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM), a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 13 stores a computer program for executing various processes in the processor 14, various data used when the various processes are executed by the processor 14, and the like. Therefore, the storage device 13 stores machine learning models specific to the respective vehicles.

The processor 14 has one or more CPUs (Central Processing Unit: central processing units) and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 14 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU (Graphics Processing Unit: graphics processing unit) or a logic arithmetic unit or a numerical arithmetic unit. The processor 14 executes various arithmetic processes based on a computer program stored in the storage device 13 of the ECU 11. Therefore, when the value of the input parameter of the machine learning model is input, the processor 14 performs the arithmetic processing according to the machine learning model, and outputs the value of the output parameter.

Fig. 3 is a functional block diagram of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2. As shown in fig. 3, the processor 14 includes a control unit 141 for controlling the control device 22 of the vehicle 2 using a machine learning model, a learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 for determining whether or not a learning execution condition of the machine learning model is satisfied, a data set generation unit 143 for generating a learning data set, a learning request transmission unit 144 for transmitting a request for machine learning to the server 3, a vehicle side learning unit 145 for performing machine learning on values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model, a model updating unit 146 for updating the machine learning model used in the control unit 141, a vehicle side transmission unit 147 for transmitting various data to the server 3, and a vehicle side reception unit 148 for receiving various data from the server 3. These functional blocks of the processor 14 are, for example, functional blocks implemented by a computer program that acts on the processor 14. Alternatively, these functional blocks of the processor 14 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 14. Details of the respective functional blocks of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2 will be described later.

As shown in fig. 2, the vehicle 2 further includes an off-vehicle communication module 21, a plurality of control devices 22, and a plurality of sensors 23. The off-vehicle communication module 21, the control device 22, and the sensor 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15.

The off-vehicle communication module 21 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with an off-vehicle device. The off-vehicle communication module 21 is, for example, a device for communicating with the server 3. The off-board communication module 21 includes, for example, a data communication module (DCM: data communication module). The data communication module communicates with the server 3 via the wireless base station 5 and the communication network 4.

The control device 22 is a device that performs various controls related to the vehicle 2. Specifically, the control device 22 includes, for example, a driving actuator of a throttle valve that adjusts the opening degree of the throttle valve provided in an intake passage of the internal combustion engine, an injector that supplies fuel to a combustion chamber of the internal combustion engine, a spark plug that ignites the fuel in the combustion chamber, a driving actuator of an EGR valve that controls the EGR rate of the internal combustion engine, a blower of an air conditioner, a driving actuator of an air mix door that controls the flow of air of the air conditioner, and the like. These control devices 22 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and operate in accordance with drive signals from the ECU 11.

The sensor 23 is an example of a detector that detects values (state amounts) of various state parameters related to the vehicle 2. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an air amount sensor that detects an intake air amount supplied to the internal combustion engine, an injection pressure sensor that detects a fuel injection pressure from an injector of the internal combustion engine, an exhaust temperature sensor that detects a temperature of exhaust gas, an input detection sensor that detects an input of a driver in a touch panel or the like, a self-position sensor (e.g., GPS) that detects a self-position of the vehicle 2, and the like. The sensor 23 includes, for example, an outside air temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the surrounding air (outside air temperature) of the vehicle 2, an outside air humidity sensor that detects the humidity of the surrounding air (outside air humidity) of the vehicle 2, an atmospheric pressure sensor that detects the atmospheric pressure around the vehicle 2, an in-vehicle temperature sensor that detects the temperature in the chamber of the vehicle 2 (in-vehicle temperature), an in-vehicle humidity sensor that detects the humidity in the chamber of the vehicle 2 (in-vehicle humidity), an insolation sensor that detects the insolation amount, and the like. These sensors 23 are connected to the ECU11 via the in-vehicle network 15, and transmit output signals to the ECU 11.

The server 3 is provided outside the vehicle 2, and communicates with the running vehicle 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5. The server 3 receives various information from the running vehicle 2.

Fig. 4 is a diagram schematically showing a hardware configuration of the server 3. As shown in fig. 4, the server 3 includes an external communication module 31, a storage device 32, and a processor 33. The server 3 may have an input device such as a keyboard and a mouse and an output device such as a display.

The external communication module 31 is an example of a communication unit that communicates with a device outside the server 3. The external communication module 31 includes an interface circuit for connecting the server 3 to the communication network 4. The external communication module 31 is configured to be capable of communicating with each of the plurality of vehicles 2 via the communication network 4 and the wireless base station 5.

The storage device 32 is an example of a storage unit that stores data. The storage device 32 of the server 3 also includes a volatile semiconductor memory (e.g., RAM), a nonvolatile semiconductor memory (e.g., ROM), a Hard Disk Drive (HDD), a Solid State Drive (SSD), or an optical recording medium. The storage device 32 stores a computer program for executing various processes by the processor 33, various data for use when executing various processes by the processor 33.

The processor 33 has one or more CPUs and peripheral circuits thereof. The processor 33 may further include an arithmetic circuit such as a GPU, a logic arithmetic unit, or a numerical arithmetic unit. The processor 33 executes various arithmetic processes based on a computer program stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3. In the present embodiment, the processor 33 of the server 3 functions as a machine learning device that machine learns a machine learning model.

Fig. 5 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3. As shown in fig. 5, the processor 33 includes a processing load detection unit 331 that detects the current processing load of the server 3, a processing amount determination unit 332 that determines the processing amount of machine learning performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2, a server side learning unit 333 that performs machine learning on values of model parameters constituting a machine learning model, a server side transmission unit 334 that transmits various data to the vehicle 2, and a server side reception unit 335 that receives various data from the vehicle 2. These functional blocks of the processor 33 are, for example, functional blocks implemented by a computer program that operates on the processor 33. Alternatively, these functional blocks of the processor 33 may be dedicated arithmetic circuits provided in the processor 33. Details of the respective functional blocks of the processor 33 of the server 3 will be described later.

Machine learning model

In the present embodiment, when the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2 controls the control device 22 mounted on the vehicle 2, a machine learning model after machine learning is used. In the present embodiment, a neural network model (hereinafter, referred to as "NN model") is used as the machine learning model. The outline of the NN model will be described below with reference to fig. 6. Fig. 6 shows an example of an NN model having a simple structure.

The circle marks in fig. 6 represent artificial neurons. Artificial neurons are commonly referred to as nodes or units (referred to as "nodes" in this specification). In fig. 6, l=1 represents an input layer, l=2 and l=3 represents a hidden layer (or intermediate layer), and l=4 represents an output layer. In the present embodiment, the number of nodes of the hidden layers (l=2 and l=3) is smaller than the number of nodes of the input layer (l=1), and the number of nodes of the lower hidden layer is smaller than the number of nodes of the upper hidden layer (for example, the number of nodes of the hidden layer (l=3) is smaller than the number of nodes of the hidden layer (l=2)).

In fig. 6, x m (m=1, 2,.. M.m. m=4 in the example shown in fig. 6) represents each node of the input layer (l=1) and an output value from the node, and y represents a node of the output layer (l=4) and an output value thereof. Also, z k(L＝2)(k＝1,2,…,K(L＝2) in the hidden layer of l=2. In the example shown in fig. 6, K (L＝2) =3 represents each node of the hidden layer (l=2) and an output value from the node, and z k(L＝3)(k＝1,2,…,K(L＝3) in the hidden layer of l=3. In the example shown in fig. 6, K (L＝3) =2 represents each node of the hidden layer (l=3) and an output value from the node.

At each node of the input layer, the input is directly output. On the other hand, the output value x m (m=1, 2,3, 4) of each node of the input layer is input to each node of the hidden layer (l=2), and the total input value u is calculated at each node of the hidden layer (l=2) using the corresponding weight w and the bias b. For example, in fig. 6, the total input value u k(L＝2) calculated at each node represented by z k(L＝2) (k=1, 2, 3) of the hidden layer (l=2) is represented by the following expression (1).

Then, the total input value u k(L＝2) is converted by the activation function f, and is output from the node denoted by z k(L＝2) of the hidden layer (l=2) as an output value z k(L＝2)(＝f(uk(L＝2)). On the other hand, the output value z k(L＝2) (k=1, 2, 3) of each node of the hidden layer (l=2) is input to each node of the hidden layer (l=3), and the total input value u (=Σz·w+b) is calculated at each node of the hidden layer (l=3) using the corresponding weight w and offset b. The total input value u is similarly converted by an activation function, and is output as an output value z k(L＝3) (k=1, 2) from each node of the hidden layer (l=3). The activation function is, for example, a ReLU function σ.

The output value z k(L＝3) (k=1, 2) of each node of the hidden layer (l=3) is input to the node of the output layer (l=4), and the total input value u (Σz·w+b) is calculated using the corresponding weight w and the bias b, or the total input value u (Σz·w) is calculated using only the corresponding weight w. For example, at the node of the output layer, an identity function is used as the activation function. In this case, the total input value u calculated at the node of the output layer is directly output from the node of the output layer as the output value y.

In this way, the NN model includes an input layer, a hidden layer, and an output layer, and if values of a plurality of input parameters are input from the input layer, values of one or more output parameters corresponding to the input parameters are output from the output layer.

In the present embodiment, as such a machine learning model, for example, a model is used in which the temperature of the exhaust gas is output as the value of the output parameter when the outside air temperature, the intake air amount, the fuel injection timing, the fuel injection pressure, and the EGR rate are input as the values of the input parameters. In the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2, the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 and the control command value from the ECU11 to the control device 22 are input to the machine learning model as the value of the input parameter, and the temperature of the exhaust gas as the output parameter is output. The control portion 141 controls the control device 22 (e.g., a driving actuator of a throttle valve, an injector, a spark plug, etc.) associated with the internal combustion engine based on the temperature of the output exhaust gas. Here, since there is a response delay in the exhaust gas temperature sensor that detects the temperature of the exhaust gas, if the control of the internal combustion engine is performed based on the output of the exhaust gas temperature sensor, the internal combustion engine may not be able to be properly controlled. In contrast, since no delay occurs in the calculation of the temperature of the exhaust gas using the machine learning model, the control device 22 related to the internal combustion engine is controlled using the temperature of the exhaust gas calculated by the machine learning model, and therefore, the internal combustion engine can be controlled more appropriately.

Alternatively, as such a machine learning model, for example, a model may be used in which, when the outside air temperature, outside air humidity, inside air temperature, inside air humidity, and insolation amount are input as values of input parameters, the target temperature of the air conditioner is output as a value of output parameters. In this case, the control unit 141 of the vehicle 2 inputs the value of the state parameter detected by the sensor 23 and the control command value from the ECU11 to the control device 22 as the value of the input parameter to the machine learning model, and outputs the target temperature of the air conditioner as the output parameter. The ECU11 controls a control device 22 (for example, a blower of an air conditioner, a driving actuator of an air mix door, and the like) related to the air conditioner such that the in-vehicle temperature becomes a target temperature output from the machine learning model.

As the machine learning model, various models can be used. Accordingly, as the input parameters, various state parameters representing the state of the vehicle, such as an outside air temperature, an outside air humidity, an atmospheric pressure, an in-vehicle temperature, an in-vehicle humidity, a solar radiation amount, an intake air temperature, a fuel injection pressure, a fuel injection timing, a fuel injection amount, an air-fuel ratio, an ignition timing, an engine cooling water temperature, and a supercharging pressure, are used. As the output parameter, various state parameters indicating the state of the vehicle, such as the temperature of the exhaust gas purification catalyst, the concentration of NOx in the exhaust gas, the engine output torque, and the humidity in the vehicle, are used.

Machine learning of machine learning model

Next, machine learning of the machine learning model (NN model) as described above will be described. In order to improve the accuracy of the machine learning model, machine learning of values of model parameters constituting the machine learning model (hereinafter, also referred to simply as "machine learning of the machine learning model") is required. Then, in the present embodiment, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 of the vehicle 2 or the server-side learning unit 333 of the server 3 performs machine learning of the machine learning model. Specifically, in the machine learning by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333, the values of all model parameters (weights w, offsets b, and the like in the case of the NN model) of the machine learning model are calculated so that the values of the appropriate output parameters corresponding to the values of the input parameters are output from the machine learning model when the values of the input parameters are input to the machine learning model. Hereinafter, a learning method of machine learning of the machine learning model performed by the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 will be briefly described.

In machine learning of a machine learning model, a training dataset comprising measured values of state parameters is used. The training data set is composed of a combination of a plurality of actual measurement values of a plurality of input parameters and a plurality of actual measurement values (forward solution data) of at least one output parameter corresponding to the actual measurement values. In the present embodiment, the actual measured value of the input parameter and the actual measured value of the output parameter are values detected by the sensor 23 of the vehicle 2 or control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 2. In the present embodiment, when the server 3 performs machine learning of the machine learning model, the training data set is transmitted from the vehicle 2 to the server 3. The training data set may be a data set obtained by preprocessing (normalizing, or the like) the actual measured value of the input parameter and the actual measured value of the output parameter.

The vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 performs machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model using the training data set. In the machine learning of the machine learning model, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 or the server-side learning unit 333 repeatedly updates the values of the model parameters (the weights w and the offsets b) in the machine learning model by a known error back propagation method, for example, so that the difference between the output value of the machine learning model and the actual measurement value of the output parameter included in the training data set becomes small. As a result, the machine learning model is learned, and a learned machine learning model is generated. The values of the model parameters (weight w, bias b, etc.) constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 13 of the vehicle 2 or the storage device 32 of the server 3.

Learning process of machine learning model

Next, a flow of learning processing of the machine learning model in the vehicle 2 or the server 3 will be described with reference to fig. 7 and 8. In the present embodiment, the main body of machine learning of the machine learning model is changed according to the processing load in the server 3. In particular, in the present embodiment, when the processing load on the server 3 is high, the vehicle 2 performs machine learning, and when the processing load on the server 3 is low, the server 3 performs machine learning. Therefore, in the present embodiment, there are a case where machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2 and a case where machine learning is performed by the server 3. Therefore, the flow of the learning process in the case where the machine learning is performed by each of the vehicle 2 and the server 3 will be described below.

Fig. 7 is an operation sequence diagram of learning processing in the case where machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the server 3. Therefore, fig. 7 shows the flow of the learning process in the case where the processing load in the server 3 is low.

The learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 of the vehicle 2 periodically determines whether or not the learning execution condition of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is satisfied (step S11). The machine learning of the machine learning model is performed, for example, at regular intervals, at regular travel distances, or at regular travel times. Therefore, for example, if a certain period of time has elapsed from the last machine learning, the learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 determines that the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. Here, the value of the optimal model parameter of the machine learning model changes due to the aged deterioration of the control device 22, the change in the direction of interest of the user, and the like. By performing machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model periodically in this manner, the values of the model parameters can be maintained at appropriate values.

The machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed at a timing different from the above-described timing. Therefore, for example, the machine learning of the machine learning model may be performed when some abnormality occurs in the control device 22 that uses the command value as the input parameter of the machine learning model and the sensor 23 that detects the value of the input parameter of the machine learning model. Therefore, in this case, the learning condition satisfaction/non-satisfaction determination unit 142 determines that the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied when the abnormality occurs in the control device 22 and the sensor 23. Specifically, for example, when it is determined by a self-diagnosis function (On-board diagnosis) that an abnormality has occurred in the control device 22 or the sensor 23, or when a predicted value output by the machine learning model differs from an actual measurement value detected by the sensor 23 by a reference value or more, a learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied.

When the learning execution condition is satisfied, the data set generating unit 143 of the vehicle 2 creates a training data set (step S12). The data set generating unit 143 generates a training data set based on the detection value detected by the sensor 23 of the vehicle 2 during an arbitrary period and the control command value transmitted from the ECU11 to the control device 22 during the period. The data set generating unit 143 generates a training data set based on the detection value and the control command value acquired after the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. Alternatively, the data set generating unit 143 may store the detection value and the control command value in the storage device 13 from the time when the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied, and generate the training data set based on the detection value and the control command value stored after the learning execution condition of the machine learning is satisfied. The data set generating unit 143 may perform preprocessing (normalization, or the like) on the detection value and the control command value to generate the training data set. The generated training data set is stored in the storage device 13 of the ECU 11.

When the training data set is generated, the learning request transmitting unit 144 of the vehicle 2 transmits a request signal for requesting machine learning of the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model to the server 3 via the off-vehicle communication module 21 (step S13). At this time, the learning request transmitting unit 144 may transmit information necessary for calculating the processing load associated with the machine learning in the server 3 together with the request signal. Specifically, the learning request transmitting unit 144 transmits, for example, the size of the training data set created by the data set generating unit 143, the structure of the machine learning model (the number of layers, the number of nodes of each layer, etc.), or the type of the machine learning model (for example, a model contributing to the safety of the vehicle 2, a model contributing to the environment, etc.). However, when information such as the structure of the machine learning model corresponding to the vehicle 2 is stored in advance in the storage device 32 of the server 3, the learning request transmitting unit 144 does not transmit the information.

On the other hand, the processing load detection unit 331 of the server 3 detects the current processing load of the server 3 at all times or periodically (step S14). The processing load of the server 3 is a load related to the arithmetic processing of the server 3, and varies, for example, according to the usage rate (CPU, GPU usage rate) of the processor 33 of the server 3 and the free capacity in the semiconductor memory of the storage device 32 of the server 3. The greater the usage of the processor 33, the higher the processing load of the server 3 is detected, and the smaller the free capacity in the semiconductor memory, the higher the processing load of the server 3 is detected.

The processing load of the server 3 varies according to the amount of arithmetic processing being performed in the server 3. Therefore, when the server 3 is learning the machine learning model of many other vehicles and is performing various arithmetic processing other than learning, the processing load of the server 3 is detected as high. On the other hand, when the server 3 does not perform learning of the machine learning model of another vehicle or arithmetic processing other than learning, the processing load of the server 3 is detected as low.

The processing load detection unit 331 may detect not only the current processing load of the server 3 but also the subsequent processing load of the server 3. The processing load to be used is detected based on, for example, a task for which processing in the processor 33 of the server 3 is planned. The processing load detection unit 331 may be configured to detect the load processing when the server-side reception unit 335 receives the request signal via the external communication module 31, instead of detecting the processing load constantly or periodically.

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives the request signal via the external communication module 31, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines the main body of machine learning the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 detected by the processing load detecting unit 331 (step S15). In particular, in the present embodiment, the throughput determining unit 332 determines whether or not the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than a predetermined reference processing load. When determining that the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than the predetermined reference processing load, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines to perform all processing in the machine learning of the machine learning model on the processor 14 of the vehicle 2, that is, to zero the processing amount of the machine learning in the processor 33 of the server 3. On the other hand, when determining that the current processing load of the server 3 is equal to or lower than the reference processing load, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines to perform all processing in the machine learning of the machine learning model in the processor 33 of the server 3, that is, to zero the processing amount of the machine learning in the processor 14 of the vehicle 2. In the present embodiment, the reference processing load is a predetermined constant value (for example, 80% when the maximum value of the processing load of the server 3 is set to 100%).

The reference processing load may be a variable value instead of a predetermined constant value. For example, the reference processing load may be changed based on the type of the machine learning model transmitted from the learning request transmitting unit 144 to the server 3. Specifically, the reference processing load is changed from high to low in the order of the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the safety of the vehicle 2, the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the environmental load caused by the vehicle 2, and the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the comfort of the occupant in the vehicle 2. Therefore, the reference processing load is set to be higher in the case where the machine learning model is a model associated with the safety of the vehicle 2 than in the case where the machine learning model is a model not associated with the safety of the vehicle 2.

As the model related to the safety of the vehicle 2, for example, a model for detecting a failure of a control device 22 (for example, an internal combustion engine, an electric motor, a brake device, a steering device, and the like) related to the driving of the vehicle mounted on the vehicle 2, and a sensor 23 (for example, an external camera, a driver monitoring camera, a radar, and the like) related to the safety can be considered. As this model, specifically, for example, a model in which the values of the state parameters detected by the various sensors 23 and the control command values from the ECU11 to the control device 22 are set as input parameters and the presence or absence of failure of each device is set as output parameters may be considered. As a model associated with the environmental load caused by the vehicle 2, for example, the above-described model for estimating the temperature of the exhaust gas can be considered. In addition, as a model related to the comfort of the occupant in the vehicle 2, for example, the above-described model for estimating the target temperature of the air conditioning apparatus may be considered.

Here, the reference processing load indicates a priority of machine learning in the server 3. When the reference processing load is low, it is not easy to perform machine learning in the server 3, and therefore machine learning in the vehicle 2, which takes a long time for machine learning, is easy to perform. Therefore, a low reference processing load means that the priority of machine learning in the server 3 is low, whereas a high reference processing load means that the priority of machine learning in the server 3 is high. Therefore, by changing the reference processing load according to the type of the machine learning model as described above, the priority of machine learning in the server 3 of the model related to the safety of the vehicle 2 can be increased, and the priority of machine learning in the server 3 of the model related to the comfort of the occupant can be reduced.

When the processing amount determining unit 332 determines that the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed in the server 3, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits a notification to the effect that the machine learning is performed in the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S16).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification that the machine learning is performed in the server 3, the vehicle-side transmitting unit 147 transmits information necessary for performing the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 via the off-vehicle communication module 21 (step S17). The information required for performing machine learning includes, for example, a training data set generated by the data set generating unit 143 and values of current model parameters of the machine learning model.

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives information necessary for performing machine learning via the external communication module 31, the server-side learning unit 333 performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model (step S18). The server-side learning unit 333 uses the training data set with the value of the current model parameter transmitted from the vehicle 2 as an initial value, and updates the value of the model parameter by a known technique such as the error back propagation method described above. As a result, the server-side learning unit 333 generates a learned machine learning model (more specifically, a relearned machine learning model based on the new training data set). The values of the model parameters (weights w and offsets b) constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 32 of the server 3.

After the machine learning of the machine learning model in the server-side learning unit 333 is completed, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits the values of the model parameters obtained by the machine learning of the server-side learning unit 333 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S19).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 of the vehicle 2 receives the values of the model parameters from the server 3 via the off-vehicle communication module 21, the model updating unit 146 of the vehicle 2 updates the values of the model parameters constituting the machine learning model used in the control unit 141 to the values received from the server 3 (step S20). Thereafter, the control unit 141 performs control of the control device 22 based on the machine learning model using the updated values of the model parameters.

As described above, in the example shown in fig. 7 of the present embodiment, it is determined that the current processing load of the server 3 is equal to or lower than the reference processing load, and in this case, the processing amount of machine learning in the vehicle 2 is determined to be zero, and the processing amount of machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be the entire processing amount of machine learning based on the training data set. In other words, it is known that in this case, the processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle 2 and the machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be 0:1.

Fig. 8 is an operation sequence diagram of learning processing in the case where machine learning of the machine learning model is performed by the vehicle 2. Therefore, fig. 8 shows the flow of the learning process in the case where the processing load in the server 3 is high.

As is clear from fig. 8, when the vehicle 2 performs the machine learning of the machine learning model, the same processing as that performed by the vehicle 2 is performed until the main body performing the machine learning of the machine learning model is determined (steps S11 to S14).

In the example shown in fig. 8, the throughput determining unit 332 determines the main body of the machine learning in the machine learning model in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 (step S15). Then, when the processing amount determining unit 332 determines that the machine learning of the machine learning model is to be performed in the vehicle 2 in step S15, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits a notification to the effect that the machine learning is to be performed in the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S21).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification that the vehicle 2 is performing the machine learning, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 performs the machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model without transmitting the training data set and the values of the current model parameters to the server 3 (step S22). The machine learning in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 is performed in the same manner as the machine learning in the server-side learning unit 333, and the vehicle-side learning unit 145 generates a learned machine learning model. The values of the model parameters constituting the learned machine learning model are stored in the storage device 32 of the vehicle 2.

When the machine learning of the machine learning model in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 is completed, the model updating unit 146 of the vehicle 2 updates the values of the model parameters constituting the machine learning model used in the control unit 141 to the values obtained by the learning in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 (step S23). Thereafter, the control unit 141 performs control of the control device 22 based on the machine learning model using the updated values of the model parameters.

As described above, in the example shown in fig. 8 of the present embodiment, it is determined that the current processing load of the server 3 is higher than the reference processing load, and in this case, the processing amount of the machine learning in the server 3 is determined to be zero, and the processing amount of the machine learning in the vehicle 2 is determined to be the entire processing amount of the machine learning based on the training data set. In other words, it is known that in this case, the processing ratio of the machine learning in the vehicle 2 and the machine learning in the server 3 is decided to be 1:0.

Effect

According to the machine learning system 1 and the machine learning method executed in the machine learning system 1 of the above-described embodiment, when the processing load in the server 3 is low, the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is performed in the server 3, and when the processing load in the server 3 is high, the machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 is performed in the vehicle 2. As a result, the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed in the server 3 having a high processing speed as much as possible, and even when there is a request for machine learning from many vehicles to the server 3, the processing load of the server 3 can be prevented from becoming excessively high.

< Second embodiment >

Next, the machine learning system 1 of the second embodiment and a machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 9 and 10. The structure and processing of the machine learning system 1 of the second embodiment are basically the same as those of the machine learning system 1 of the first embodiment. The following description focuses on points different from the machine learning system 1 of the first embodiment.

In the machine learning system 1 of the first embodiment, the reference processing load used when determining the server 3 and the main body of the vehicle 2 for machine learning of the machine learning model is set to a constant value or a value that varies according to the type of the machine learning model. In contrast, in the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set in consideration of the time required until the value of the learned model parameter is obtained in the vehicle 2 (hereinafter, also referred to as "server processing required time") in the case where the machine learning is performed in the server 3 and the time required until the value of the learned model parameter is obtained in the vehicle 2 (hereinafter, also referred to as "vehicle processing required time") in the case where the machine learning is performed in the vehicle 2.

More specifically, in the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set so that the necessity of processing in the server 3 is low when the time required for the server processing is longer than the time required for the vehicle processing, and therefore, the machine learning is performed in the vehicle 2, and the machine learning is performed in the server 3 or the vehicle 2 when the time required for the server processing is equal to or shorter than the time required for the vehicle processing. A specific method of setting the reference processing load will be described below.

Fig. 9 is a functional block diagram of the processor 33 of the server 3 of the present embodiment. As shown in fig. 9, in the present embodiment, the processor 33 includes a reference throughput calculating unit 336 that calculates a reference throughput in addition to the functional blocks of the processor 33 of the first embodiment.

Fig. 10 is a sequence diagram of operations similar to fig. 7 of learning processing performed by the server 3 in the machine learning model of the present embodiment. As shown in fig. 10, in the present embodiment, when the server-side receiving unit 335 receives a request signal via the external communication module 31, the reference throughput calculating unit 336 calculates a reference throughput.

When calculating the reference processing amount, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 calculates an expected vehicle learning time that is spent assuming that the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed in the vehicle side learning unit 145, based on the training data set generated by the data set generation unit 143. The expected vehicle learning time is calculated based on, for example, the processing capability of the processor 14 of the vehicle 2 and the capacity of the semiconductor memory, the size of the training data set, and the configuration of the machine learning model. It is expected that the vehicle learning time is calculated so as to be shorter as the processing capacity of the vehicle 2 is higher, and calculated so as to be longer as the size of the training data set is larger and the structure of the machine learning model is more complex.

In addition, the reference throughput calculating unit 336 calculates an expected communication time required for transmission and reception between the vehicle 2 and the server 3, which are values of the training data set and the model parameters, when calculating the reference throughput. This expected communication time is a time required for machine learning by the server 3. The expected communication time is calculated based on, for example, the size of the training data set, the number of model parameters of the machine learning model, and the communication strength of wireless communication between the vehicle 2 and the server 3. The expected communication time is calculated so that the larger the size of the training data set and the larger the number of model parameters, the longer the communication strength of the wireless communication, and the shorter the communication strength of the wireless communication. The communication intensity of the wireless communication may include not only the current communication intensity but also future expected communication intensity. The future expected communication intensity is estimated, for example, from a future planned travel route of the vehicle 2. Therefore, for example, when the vehicle 2 is scheduled to travel on a mountain road with low communication intensity, the future expected communication intensity is set to a low value.

Then, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 calculates a difference time obtained by subtracting the estimated communication time from the estimated vehicle learning time in the vehicle 2. When the machine learning in the server 3 takes longer than the difference time calculated in this way, this means that the time required for the server process is longer than the time required for the vehicle process. On the other hand, when the time spent for machine learning in the server 3 is equal to or less than the difference time calculated in this way, it means that the time required for server processing is equal to or less than the time required for vehicle processing.

On the other hand, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 varies according to the processing load of the server 3. When the processing load of the server 3 is high, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 is slow, and thus the time required for machine learning becomes long. In contrast, when the processing load of the server 3 is low, the arithmetic processing speed in the server 3 is high, and thus the time required for machine learning is shortened.

Then, in the present embodiment, the reference processing amount calculation unit 336 sets a load (hereinafter referred to as "difference time equivalent load") requiring the above-described difference time for performing the machine learning of the machine learning model in the server 3 as the reference processing load. As a result, since the server 3 performs the machine learning when the current processing load is equal to or less than the reference processing load, the server 3 performs the machine learning only when the time required for the server processing is equal to or less than the time required for the vehicle processing.

In the present embodiment, the reference processing load is set to be a load corresponding to the difference time. However, the reference processing load may be set to a load lower than the difference time equivalent load. Even in this case, the server 3 can be made to perform the machine learning only when the time required for the server processing is equal to or less than the time required for the vehicle processing. The reference processing load may be, for example, a load lower than the load corresponding to the difference time and may be a load that varies according to the type of the machine learning model.

< Third embodiment >

Next, the machine learning system 1 of the third embodiment and a machine learning method performed in the machine learning system 1 will be described with reference to fig. 11. The structure and processing of the machine learning system 1 of the third embodiment are basically the same as those of the machine learning system 1 of the first and second embodiments. The following description focuses on differences from the machine learning system 1 of the first and second embodiments.

In the machine learning system 1 according to the first and second embodiments, all the machine learning processes are performed in either the vehicle 2 or the server 3. In contrast, in the present embodiment, the machine learning process of the machine learning model is performed in a distributed manner in the vehicle 2 and the server 3 according to the processing load of the server 3.

Fig. 11 is a sequence diagram of operations of the learning process according to the present embodiment, which is similar to fig. 7. The same steps as those in the process performed in fig. 7 are denoted by the same step numbers, and a description thereof is omitted.

In the present embodiment, as shown in fig. 11, when the server-side receiving unit 335 receives the request signal, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines the processing amount of the machine learning performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2 based on the current processing load of the server 3 detected by the processing load detecting unit 331 (step S35). In the present embodiment, the higher the current processing load of the server 3, the smaller the processing amount of the machine learning in the server 3, and the larger the processing amount of the machine learning in the vehicle 2. The processing amount of the machine learning in the server 3 and the vehicle 2 may be changed stepwise or continuously according to the processing load. Therefore, when the present processing load of the server 3 is relatively high in all the embodiments including the first and second embodiments, the processing amount of machine learning in the server 3 is reduced compared to that in the case of relatively low.

When the throughput is determined by the throughput determining unit 332, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits the notification of the throughput of each of the vehicle 2 and the server 3 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S36). When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the notification, the vehicle-side transmitting unit 147 transmits information necessary for performing machine learning of the machine learning model of the vehicle 2 via the off-vehicle communication module 21 (step S17).

When the server-side receiving unit 335 receives information necessary for performing machine learning via the external communication module 31, the server-side learning unit 333 performs machine learning on the values of the model parameters of the machine learning model according to the processing amount in the server 3 determined in step S35 (step S37). The server-side learning unit 333 uses the current value of the model parameter transmitted from the vehicle 2 as an initial value, and updates the value of the model parameter by a known technique such as the error back propagation method described above using the training data set. At this time, the server-side learning unit 333 ends the machine learning process before the machine learning of the machine learning model is completed, as long as the processing amount in the server 3 determined in step S35 is not the entire processing amount of the machine learning.

After the completion of the learning of the machine learning model in the server-side learning unit 333, the server-side transmitting unit 334 transmits the values of the model parameters in the middle of the learning obtained by the machine learning of the server-side learning unit 333 to the vehicle 2 via the external communication module 31 (step S38).

When the vehicle-side receiving unit 148 receives the value of the model parameter during learning, the vehicle-side learning unit 145 sets the value of the model parameter during learning transmitted from the server 3 as an initial value, and performs machine learning on the value of the model parameter of the machine learning model based on the processing amount in the vehicle 2 determined in step S35 using the training data set (step S39). The machine learning in the vehicle-side learning unit 145 is performed until the learning is completed, and the vehicle-side learning unit 145 generates a learned machine learning model.

In the above embodiment, the processing amount determining unit 332 determines the processing amount of the machine learning performed in each of the server 3 and the vehicle 2. However, the throughput determination unit 332 may determine a ratio (processing ratio) of the throughput performed by the server 3 to the throughput performed by the vehicle 2. In the above embodiment, first, the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed halfway in the server 3, and then, the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed to completion in the vehicle 2. However, it is also possible that the machine learning of the machine learning model is first performed halfway in the vehicle 2, and then the machine learning of the machine learning model is performed to completion in the server 3.
